title: Avarice: Gates of Greed
description: Standalone Mod of the Avarice - Gates of ascension modpack - This mod is not recomended for standalone use
body:
![Avarice: Gates of Greed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba06b63008dd13a8fbbe7df3cd8b3e51650f3a42.png)
## **Currently in Beta - Not Feature Complete**

Avarice is a fast-paced, action dungeon crawler built around Minecraft.

Enter the dungeon, gather loot, and bail out to survive—because dying in the dungeon means losing it all. Don’t let your greed get the best of you.

Survive as many waves as possible, adding cards to your deck to increase item multipliers and difficulty. Upgrade your weapons and gear with coins, then choose the right moment to bail and claim your bounty.

Level up through meta progression and re-enter the dungeon stronger each time. Upgrade your skills, complete quests, and push further with every run, testing your luck again and again. But be careful—death means starting over and losing everything you earned.

Earn cards from loot boxes and modify future runs to maximise your rewards and customise your playstyle.

How long can you survive? How far will your greed take you?

Find out in this unique roguelite experience.
